member.name: T:EntitySpaces.DynamicQuery.esSubquerySearchCondition
member.summary:
ANY, ALL, and SOME are SubQuery qualifiers.
SubQuery qualifiers precede the SubQuery they apply to. For most databases, ANY and SOME are synonymous. Usually, if you use an operator (= | <> | != | > | >= | !> | < | <= | !<) in a Where clause against a SubQuery, then the SubQuery must return a single value. By applying a qualifier to the SubQuery, you can use operators against SubQueries that return multiple results.
